item.title: APC committee begins work to resolve internal disputes ahead of 2027 elections
item.description: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has activated its strategy, conflict resolution and mobilisation committee to address lingering internal disputes and strengthen party unity ahead of future elections. In December 2025, President Bola Tinubu inaugurated the committee to resolve disputes within the APC ahead of the 2027 general election. item.title: 18-year-old Leonard Ngenge joins Leeds United from Remo Stars
item.description: Leonard Ngenge has joined Leeds United FC from Remo Stars. The English Premier League (EPL) club announced the signing in a statement on Tuesday. Leeds said the 18-year-old defender penned a one-and-a-half-year deal that would see him at the club till the end of the 2026/27 season. item.description: Babatunde Fashola, former governor of Lagos and ex-minister of power, works, and housing, says newly appointed Nigerian ambassadors must possess deep knowledge of the country’s policies to effectively attract foreign investment. item.title: Family Debunks Missing Report on Iya Oge of Lagos, Says She’s Abroad
item.description: The family of Opral Benson, the Iya Oge of Lagos, has dismissed claims that she is missing, saying she is currently out of the country. A missing person notice released on Sunday had claimed that Benson’s whereabouts had been unknown. It added that she was last seen on January 13 and had not returned home since then.
